pass_condition: The packet's source size is within its declared class (L <= 800 lines).

evidence.command: env -u PYTEST_ADDOPTS PYTHONPATH=<tree> python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/store/

findings.statement: porchlamp/store is 939 source lines against the L class's 800, and the excess is nameable rather than structural.
findings.failure_scenario: The deviation is logged in the handoff and consistent with prior accepted packets, but it was accepted without naming what could go; the named subtractions below bring it to roughly 800 without cutting behaviour.

observations: Composition measured: writer.py 353 (77 docstring), schema.py 212 (64 docstring), reader.py 159 (43 docstring), migrations/__init__.py 96 (34 docstring), 0001_init_v2.sql 108 (10 comment), __init__.py 11. Prose is 245 of 939 lines.

Subtractable without losing behaviour: writer.py's three ownership-request paragraphs (about 30 lines, duplicated verbatim in .agents/W4-2/handoff.md) and schema.py's four-deviation block (about 35 lines, same duplication) -- the handoff is the right home for both; reader.py's _TIE_GROUP_ORDER_BY_SQL plus the DENSE_RANK column and its test (about 20 lines), which R-D hands to W4-3 anyway. That is roughly 85 lines, landing near 855.

The largest single duplication is 0001_init_v2.sql's 98 DDL lines against schema.py's identical SCHEMA_STATEMENTS, kept deliberately as two artifacts a parity test binds. Generating one from the other would remove about 98 lines and reach 800, but a forward-only migration should stay frozen text; the duplication is defensible and the recommendation is to keep it and accept ~855 instead.

not_checked.statement: W4-3's persona re-projection SQL and W4-4's endpoints are not in this packet; only the reader helpers they build on were checked.
